sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于对设计的热爱以及围绕设计产生的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片做DJ的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a visit to a call center shows the long-term toll on mental health in a place where the storm has long passed and the rest of the world has moved on.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们探访了一家呼叫中心，它揭示了在风暴早已平息、世界其他地方已然前行之后，人们在心理健康方面所承受的长期代价。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月8日，星期四。

sentences.en: Caitlin, describe for me what you see as you walk into the call center.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，请描述一下你走进这家呼叫中心时所看到的景象。

sentences.en: It's almost like walking into a teeny little elementary school classroom.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像走进了一间小小的、简陋的小学教室。

sentences.en: Caitlin Dickerson is a national reporter for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·迪克森是《纽约时报》的一名全国记者。

sentences.en: There are low ceilings, tile floors, fluorescent lighting.
sentences.zh: 那里天花板很低，铺着瓷砖地板，亮着荧光灯。

sentences.en: There are signs posted with thumbtacks up on the desks that remind the call center workers to speak with compassion, to speak with love.
sentences.zh: 桌子上用图钉贴着标语，提醒呼叫中心的工作人员要怀着同情心、怀着爱去沟通。

sentences.en: And they're sitting in these little cramped cubicles right next to each other.
sentences.zh: 他们就坐在这些狭窄的小隔间里，彼此紧挨着。

sentences.en: They have a computer and then they each have multiple phones because sometimes they have to pass phones back and forth to one another in an emergency so that two or three people can be working with one caller at a time.
sentences.zh: 他们每人有一台电脑，还有好几部电话，因为有时在紧急情况下，他们必须把电话传来传去，这样两三个人才能同时协助一位来电者。

sentences.en: And the phones in this room just ring constantly.
sentences.zh: 屋子里的电话铃声此起彼伏，响个不停。

sentences.en: I was standing next to this woman named Maria.
sentences.zh: 我当时就站在一位叫玛丽亚的女士旁边。

sentences.en: She's worked there for four years.
sentences.zh: 她已经在那里工作四年了。

sentences.en: She's got curly hair and a really big smile.
sentences.zh: 她留着卷发，笑容非常灿烂。

sentences.en: She's expressive when she talks.
sentences.zh: 她说话时表情很丰富。

sentences.en: And every day she comes to work, she sits down at a cubicle and she starts taking these phone calls.
sentences.zh: 每天上班时，她都会坐进隔间，开始接听这些电话。

sentences.en: And when I was there, she got a really intense one.
sentences.zh: 我当时在场时，她接到了一通非常紧急的电话。

sentences.en: She's saying I need to practice breathing with you.
sentences.zh: 她说，我需要和你一起练习呼吸。

sentences.en: And I can tell you're distressed.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到你很痛苦。

sentences.en: And I need to help lower your levels of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我需要帮你降低焦虑水平。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: So, let's practice.
sentences.zh: 来，我们练习一下。

sentences.en: Okay, you're going to inhale smoothly through your nose and then exhale through your mouth.
sentences.zh: 好，你要通过鼻子平稳地吸气，然后通过嘴呼气。

sentences.en: And we're going to do it three times on the count of three.
sentences.zh: 我们要在数到三的时候做三次。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: One, two, three.
sentences.zh: 一，二，三。

sentences.en: Inhale slowly through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地通过鼻子吸气，通过嘴呼气。

sentences.en: Again, inhale through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
sentences.zh: 再来一次，通过鼻子吸气，通过嘴呼气。

sentences.en: This helps us, right?
sentences.zh: 这能帮到我们，对吧？

sentences.en: This helps us calm down a little.
sentences.zh: 这能帮我们平静一点。

sentences.en: I ask her, please.
sentences.zh: 我求求你。

sentences.en: I don't know her.
sentences.zh: 我不认识她。

sentences.en: And for me, her life is important.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，她的生命很重要。

sentences.en: She says, I don't know you, but your life is important to me.
sentences.zh: 她说，我不认识你，但你的生命对我来说很重要。

sentences.en: I want to ask you, these plans, are they structured?
sentences.zh: 我想问你，这些计划，是有预谋的吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to take your life by taking pills?
sentences.zh: 你想通过吃药来结束自己的生命吗？

sentences.en: But you do matter.
sentences.zh: 但你确实很重要。

sentences.en: You are important.
sentences.zh: 你很重要。

sentences.en: She's saying material things, those can be recovered.
sentences.zh: 她说物质的东西是可以挽回的。

sentences.en: But your life, you can't get that back.
sentences.zh: 但你的生命，一旦失去就无法重来。

sentences.en: What do we know about the person on the other end of this phone call?
sentences.zh: 关于电话那头的人，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: So Maria told me that she's a 45-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚告诉我，那是一位45岁的女性。

sentences.en: She was born and raised in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 她在波多黎各出生长大。

sentences.en: She's been working at a department store.
sentences.zh: 她一直在百货商店工作。

sentences.en: She lived alone.
sentences.zh: 她独自生活。

sentences.en: And about six years ago, she saved up enough money to buy her own house.
sentences.zh: 大约六年前，她攒够了钱买了自己的房子。

sentences.en: So she was really kind of living the dream.
sentences.zh: 所以她当时算是过上了梦想中的生活。

sentences.en: And then the hurricane hit.
sentences.zh: 然后飓风来了。

sentences.en: Hurricane Maria making landfall in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 飓风“玛丽亚”在波多黎各登陆。

sentences.en: The island is getting pummeled with life-threatening winds and widespread flooding.
sentences.zh: 岛上正遭受着致命大风和大规模洪水的重创。

sentences.en: We're down here on the street level where conditions are just getting worse.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在街道上，情况正在变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: The winds are so powerful and they're only getting stronger.
sentences.zh: 风力非常强劲，而且还在不断增强。

sentences.en: Snapping trees and tearing off rooftops.
sentences.zh: 树木被折断，屋顶被掀翻。

sentences.en: 150 mile an hour winds ripping buildings apart, knocking out power everywhere.
sentences.zh: 时速150英里的大风撕裂了建筑物，导致到处停电。

sentences.en: All of the electricity is out tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚全岛电力中断。

sentences.en: One official saying the island is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 一位官员称这座岛屿已被摧毁。

sentences.en: The department store is so damaged in the storm that it shuts down.
sentences.zh: 那家百货商店在风暴中受损严重，被迫关闭。

sentences.en: So this woman loses her job, the job that helped her buy this house and have this life.
sentences.zh: 所以这位女士失去了工作，那份让她买得起房、过上那种生活的工作。

sentences.en: She loses her job.
sentences.zh: 她失去了工作。

sentences.en: She loses her car in the storm.
sentences.zh: 她在风暴中失去了汽车。

sentences.en: And she was evacuated.
sentences.zh: 她被疏散了。

sentences.en: She'd been staying with a friend.
sentences.zh: 她一直寄宿在朋友家。

sentences.en: So on this day, this is the first time she actually returns to her house.
sentences.zh: 所以这一天，是她第一次真正回到自己的房子。

sentences.en: And she plans to start cleaning, start going back to life as much as she can.
sentences.zh: 她打算开始清理，尽可能地恢复正常生活。

sentences.en: But she finds that the house is devastated.
sentences.zh: 但她发现房子已经被毁了。

sentences.en: The roof is gone.
sentences.zh: 屋顶没了。

sentences.en: The windows are gone.
sentences.zh: 窗户没了。

sentences.en: Her possessions are completely destroyed.
sentences.zh: 她的财物被彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: And she has this bottle of pills, this medication that she takes normally, but that if she takes enough of it, it could kill her.
sentences.zh: 她有一瓶药，那是她平时服用的药物，但如果服用过量，可能会要了她的命。

sentences.en: And so when she starts to think about doing that is when she makes this emergency phone call.
sentences.zh: 所以当她开始萌生那种念头时，她拨打了这通紧急求助电话。

sentences.en: And what number is she calling?
sentences.zh: 她拨打的是什么号码？

sentences.en: Who does she think she's calling?
sentences.zh: 她以为自己在打给谁？

sentences.en: We actually don't know who she called because in Puerto Rico, if you call 911 or if you call a police station or if you call an emergency room and you say that you're suicidal,
sentences.zh: 我们其实不知道她打给了谁，因为在波多黎各，如果你拨打911，或者拨打警察局，或者拨打急诊室，说你有自杀倾向，

sentences.en: all of those phone calls are routed to this one call center that I visited.
sentences.zh: 所有这些电话都会被转接到我探访的这个呼叫中心。

sentences.en: It's open 24 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 它全天24小时开放。

sentences.en: It's run by the Puerto Rican government.
sentences.zh: 由波多黎各政府运营。

sentences.en: And ever since Maria hit, the calls have increased really dramatically.
sentences.zh: 自从“玛丽亚”飓风袭击以来，求助电话急剧增加。

sentences.en: Caitlin, how did you end up reporting from inside this call center in Puerto Rico?
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，你是怎么最终在波多黎各的这家呼叫中心内部进行报道的？

sentences.en: Well, I got there because I had spent a few weeks covering the storm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我到那里是因为我花了几个星期报道这场风暴。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, traditional natural disaster coverage.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那属于传统的自然灾害报道。

sentences.en: We're looking at how many people were killed, how many people were injured.
sentences.zh: 我们关注有多少人死亡，多少人受伤。

sentences.en: What does the infrastructure of the island look like?
sentences.zh: 岛上的基础设施状况如何？

sentences.en: But as time passes, it starts to become clear that this is not like the other hurricanes that hit Florida and hit Texas earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，人们开始清楚地意识到，这与今年早些时候袭击佛罗里达和德克萨斯的飓风不同。

sentences.en: This is a really specific situation that Puerto Rico is dealing with.
sentences.zh: 这是波多黎各正在处理的一种非常特殊的情况。

sentences.en: This morning at San Juan's main port, critically needed supplies and thousands of shipping containers are just sitting there
sentences.zh: 今天早上在圣胡安的主要港口，急需的物资和数千个集装箱就堆在那里，

sentences.en: and not getting to people who need them in the wake of Hurricane Maria.
sentences.zh: 却无法在“玛丽亚”飓风过后送到需要它们的人手中。

sentences.en: We're on an island.
sentences.zh: 我们身处一座岛屿上。

sentences.en: Resources and supplies aren't coming in from the mainland as quickly as people would expect them to.
sentences.zh: 资源和物资无法像人们预期的那样迅速从大陆运过来。

sentences.en: 85% of Puerto Rico's cell phone towers, landlines, and internet cables are disabled.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各85%的手机信号塔、固定电话和互联网电缆都已瘫痪。

sentences.en: The infrastructure isn't coming back.
sentences.zh: 基础设施无法恢复。

sentences.en: All of the electricity is out tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚全岛电力中断。

sentences.en: And some areas may not have it restored for months.
sentences.zh: 有些地区可能几个月都无法恢复供电。

sentences.en: The power grid isn't coming back online.
sentences.zh: 电网无法恢复运行。

sentences.en: I'm just concerned that we may not get to everybody in time.
sentences.zh: 我只是担心我们可能无法及时救助所有人。

sentences.en: And it's not clear who to blame.
sentences.zh: 而且不清楚该责怪谁。

sentences.en: It's been exactly five weeks, four months, since hurricanes swept through the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 飓风席卷加勒比地区已经整整五周零四个月了。

sentences.en: About half of Puerto Ricans remain without electricity.
sentences.zh: 大约一半的波多黎各人仍然没有电力供应。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there's this sense on the island that the rest of the world has sort of moved on.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，岛上有一种感觉，觉得世界其他地方已经把他们抛在脑后了。

sentences.en: That the public is not paying any attention and that nobody really cares.
sentences.zh: 觉得公众根本不关注，也没人真正在乎。

sentences.en: And so as I'm talking to people, it's kind of against that backdrop that I start to hear over and over again.
sentences.zh: 所以当我与人们交谈时，就是在这种背景下，我开始一次又一次地听到这些声音。

sentences.en: And people telling me about having panic attacks, about not being able to sleep, about feeling depressed and anxious.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我他们会惊恐发作，无法入睡，感到抑郁和焦虑。

sentences.en: Some people who struggled with mental illness before, but a lot of people who'd never experienced anything like this.
sentences.zh: 有些人以前就有心理健康问题，但很多人以前从未经历过这样的事情。

sentences.en: And now we're talking about suicide.
sentences.zh: 现在我们谈论的是自杀问题。

sentences.en: And so I started asking around.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始四处打听。

sentences.en: And sure enough, emergency rooms said they had been filling up with people who had suicidal thoughts.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，急诊室说他们已经挤满了有自杀念头的人。

sentences.en: And then I went to the Puerto Rican government and they acknowledged that there were signs of a full-blown mental health crisis.
sentences.zh: 然后我去了波多黎各政府，他们承认确实出现了全面心理健康危机的迹象。

sentences.en: Is that an entirely new phenomenon in Puerto Rico as a result of the storm, the idea of a mental health crisis?
sentences.zh: 心理健康危机这个概念，是风暴导致波多黎各出现的一个全新现象吗？

sentences.en: Well, remember that Puerto Rico has been dealing with a 10-year economic recession that has caused massive unemployment.
sentences.zh: 嗯，要记住波多黎各一直在应对长达十年的经济衰退，这导致了大规模的失业。

sentences.en: Nearly half the island was living in poverty.
sentences.zh: 岛上近一半的人口生活在贫困之中。

sentences.en: Huge numbers of people had fled the island.
sentences.zh: 大量人口逃离了该岛。

sentences.en: And so the island's mental health was steadily getting worse.
sentences.zh: 所以岛上的心理健康状况一直在稳步恶化。

sentences.en: And in many ways, the storm just added to that in really dramatic fashion.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，风暴只是以一种非常剧烈的方式加剧了这种情况。

sentences.en: And you see it in the ways that people's daily lives have been upended, but also just in the trauma that they experienced from the storm itself.
sentences.zh: 你从人们日常生活被颠覆的方式中可以看到这一点，也能从他们因风暴本身所经历的创伤中感受到。

sentences.en: So, you know, while I was there, the night before I visited the call center, in fact, there was a massive rainstorm.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我在那里的时候，事实上就在我探访呼叫中心的前一天晚上，下了一场大暴雨。

sentences.en: And calls went up the next day and callers would say, you know, as soon as I see the rain,
sentences.zh: 第二天电话就多了起来，来电者会说，你知道，只要我看到下雨，

sentences.en: as soon as I see the sky turn gray or a little bit of water start to puddle on the ground,
sentences.zh: 只要我看到天空变灰，或者地上开始出现一点积水，

sentences.en: I'm brought back to Hurricane Maria, and people were having what they call catastrophic thoughts, where they would think, I'm going to drown, I'm going to lose everything,
sentences.zh: 我就回想起了“玛丽亚”飓风，人们会产生所谓的灾难性想法，他们会想，我要淹死了，我将失去一切，

sentences.en: I'm going to die.
sentences.zh: 我要死了。

sentences.en: So that, to me, was a really clear illustration of how much worse Hurricane Maria has made the circumstances on the island.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这非常清楚地说明了“玛丽亚”飓风让岛上的情况变得有多糟糕。

sentences.en: So when this woman's call lands at the center, what is Maria trained to do in this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，当这位女士的电话打进中心时，玛丽亚在这一刻受过什么培训？

sentences.en: So Maria has to establish a couple of things right away.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚必须立即确定几件事。

sentences.en: She needs to find out whether the woman has a structured plan for how she might hurt herself.
sentences.zh: 她需要查明这位女士是否有伤害自己的具体计划。

sentences.en: And the second is, when is the last time she's thought about the plan?
sentences.zh: 第二点是，她上次想到这个计划是什么时候？

sentences.en: When does she think she might actually do it?
sentences.zh: 她认为自己什么时候会真的付诸行动？

sentences.en: And in this case, not only does the woman have a plan, she knows exactly how she wants to do it, but she's telling Maria, I'm going to do this right now.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这位女士不仅有计划，而且清楚地知道她想怎么做，她还告诉玛丽亚，我马上就要这么做了。

sentences.en: So this is the most dire type of phone call that comes into the call center.
sentences.zh: 所以这是呼叫中心接到的最危急的那种电话。

sentences.en: This woman's life is in imminent danger.
sentences.zh: 这位女士的生命正处于迫在眉睫的危险之中。

sentences.en: So Maria has to get someone else involved, and she doesn't even have time to turn to the police.
sentences.zh: 所以玛丽亚必须让其他人介入，她甚至没有时间去联系警察。

sentences.en: So she asks the woman on the phone, can I talk to somebody who's nearby, someone who you trust?
sentences.zh: 于是她问电话那头的女士，我能和附近的人谈谈吗，你信任的人？

sentences.en: And the woman sort of refers to a neighbor, but she resists putting the neighbor on the phone with Maria.
sentences.zh: 那位女士提到了一个邻居，但她拒绝让邻居接听玛丽亚的电话。

sentences.en: And Maria is sort of pleading with her about it, because this is really her only option.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚在恳求她，因为这确实是她唯一的选择。

sentences.en: The phones are ringing really loudly in the background, and Maria actually raises her voice, and she starts to say kind of forcefully,
sentences.zh: 背景里的电话铃声响得很厉害，玛丽亚实际上提高了嗓门，开始强硬地说，

sentences.en: You know, please, I need you to put me in contact with your neighbor, okay?
sentences.zh: 你知道，拜托，我需要你让我联系你的邻居，好吗？

sentences.en: What is her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: She repeats it.
sentences.zh: 她重复了一遍。

sentences.en: What is her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Okay, can you connect me with her?
sentences.zh: 好，你能让我联系她吗？

sentences.en: Okay, so you're going to walk outside, and you're going to connect me with your neighbor, okay?
sentences.zh: 好，你现在走出去，让我联系你的邻居，好吗？

sentences.en: The situation in Puerto Rico seems insurmountable at the moment.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各目前的局势似乎难以克服。

sentences.en: So what can these hotline workers do or say to actually make things better?
sentences.zh: 那么这些热线工作人员能做什么或说什么来真正改善现状呢？

sentences.en: Well, here's the problem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问题就在这里。

sentences.en: I mean, the main tool and the training that they have is to convince somebody not to do something drastic, not to take their own life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们拥有的主要工具和培训就是说服某人不要做极端的事情，不要结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: You do it by telling them that whatever it is that they're dealing with right now is going to pass, that it's only temporary, and that things are going to get better.
sentences.zh: 你通过告诉他们，无论他们现在面临什么，都会过去，这只是暂时的，一切都会好起来的，来做到这一点。

sentences.en: But is that true?
sentences.zh: 但这是真的吗？

sentences.en: But these workers don't know that.
sentences.zh: 但这些工作人员并不知道。

sentences.en: Nobody knows that.
sentences.zh: 没人知道答案。

sentences.en: I mean, it's very unclear how the economy is going to recover in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，波多黎各的经济将如何复苏，目前还很不明确。

sentences.en: It's very unclear how people are going to get electricity back and get warm meals again.
sentences.zh: 人们将如何恢复供电、重新吃上热乎饭菜，这也很不明确。

sentences.en: And a lot of the workers at the call center themselves are living without electricity, living without water.
sentences.zh: 而且呼叫中心的许多员工自己也过着没有电、没有水的生活。

sentences.en: You know, their prospects feel bleak.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们的前景看起来很黯淡。

sentences.en: And so they feel like they're working with their hands tied behind their backs because that most compelling argument that they tend to make, they can't really do it honestly.
sentences.zh: 所以他们感觉自己像是被束缚住了手脚，因为他们最想提出的那个最有力的论点，他们却无法真正坦诚地表达出来。

sentences.en: Kaelin, how does this phone call that you've been telling us about, how does it end?
sentences.zh: 凯琳，你刚才提到的那通电话，最后是怎么结束的？

sentences.en: So Maria finally convinces the caller to walk outside and put her neighbor on the phone.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚最终说服了打电话的人走到外面，让她的邻居接听电话。

sentences.en: And then Maria starts talking to her.
sentences.zh: 然后玛丽亚开始和她交谈。

sentences.en: She says, I asked her neighbor to hand you the phone because she's having suicidal thoughts.
sentences.zh: 她说，我让你的邻居把电话交给你，是因为她产生了自杀的念头。

sentences.en: They're structured thoughts.
sentences.zh: 那是经过深思熟虑的想法。

sentences.en: She's planning to commit suicide and to use medication.
sentences.zh: 她正计划自杀，并打算服用药物。

sentences.en: And so that's why I'm asking you not to leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 所以我请求你不要让她一个人待着。

sentences.en: And in fact, if you can accompany her and find the pills that she has, ask her where they are and make sure that you have them on you and that she can't touch them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你能陪着她，找到她手里的药，问清楚药在哪里，并确保药在你手里，让她碰不到，那就更好了。

sentences.en: And then she says, please do not leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，请千万不要让她一个人待着。

sentences.en: So eventually, the neighbor hands the phone back to the caller.
sentences.zh: 最终，邻居把电话还给了打电话的人。

sentences.en: Maria explains that she's going to the hospital, that she's going to get mental health care.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚解释说她要去医院，去接受心理健康治疗。

sentences.en: You're not alone.
sentences.zh: 你并不孤单。

sentences.en: She says, every problem has a solution.
sentences.zh: 她说，每一个问题都有解决办法。

sentences.en: And she ends the call by saying, we're here to help you.
sentences.zh: 她在通话结束时说，我们随时准备为你提供帮助。

sentences.en: Everything is going to work out.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Helen, thank you.
sentences.zh: 海伦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Four months after Hurricane Maria hit Puerto Rico, roughly one third of residents are still without power.
sentences.zh: 飓风“玛丽亚”袭击波多黎各四个月后，大约三分之一的居民仍然处于断电状态。

sentences.en: And while officially, 64 people were counted dead as a result of the storm,
sentences.zh: 虽然官方统计显示，飓风造成的死亡人数为64人，

sentences.en: Time's analysis of federal data has told a much different story.
sentences.zh: 但《时代》周刊对联邦数据的分析得出了截然不同的结论。

sentences.en: On tomorrow's daily, the true cost of the storm.
sentences.zh: 在明天的《每日新闻》中，我们将探讨这场风暴的真实代价。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Madam President.
sentences.zh: 议长女士。

sentences.en: The Majority Leader.
sentences.zh: 多数党领袖。

sentences.en: Madam President, I'm pleased to announce that our bipartisan, bicameral negotiations on defense spending and other priorities have yielded a significant agreement.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，我很高兴地宣布，我们两党、两院关于国防开支和其他优先事项的谈判已经达成了一项重大协议。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, on the Senate floor, Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer announced a sweeping two-year budget deal
sentences.zh: 周三下午，参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔和少数党领袖查克·舒默在参议院会议厅宣布了一项为期两年的全面预算协议，

sentences.en: that could break the cycle of fiscal crisis and government shutdown that have plagued Washington for the past year.
sentences.zh: 该协议有望打破过去一年困扰华盛顿的财政危机和政府停摆的恶性循环。

sentences.en: This bill is the product of extensive negotiations among congressional leaders and the White House.
sentences.zh: 这项法案是国会领导人和白宫之间广泛谈判的成果。

sentences.en: No one would suggest it is perfect, but we worked hard to find common ground and stay focused on serving the American people.
sentences.zh: 没有人会说它是完美的，但我们努力寻求共识，并始终专注于为美国人民服务。

sentences.en: The proposal delivers the increase in military funding demanded by Republicans and the higher spending on domestic programs sought by Democrats,
sentences.zh: 该提案实现了共和党要求的增加军费开支，以及民主党寻求的增加国内项目支出，

sentences.en: adding up to hundreds of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 总额高达数千亿美元。

sentences.en: To accommodate the new spending, the deal raises the national debt limit.
sentences.zh: 为了适应新的支出，该协议提高了国家债务上限。

sentences.en: After months of legislative log jams, this budget deal is a genuine breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 在经历了数月的立法僵局后，这项预算协议是一个真正的突破。

sentences.en: After months of fiscal brinkmanship, this budget deal is the first real sprout of bipartisanship.
sentences.zh: 在经历了数月的财政边缘政策博弈后，这项预算协议是两党合作的第一抹曙光。

sentences.en: In the House, Speaker Paul Ryan said he would support the proposal, but Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi said she would oppose it
sentences.zh: 在众议院，议长保罗·瑞安表示他将支持该提案，但少数党领袖南希·佩洛西表示她将反对该提案，

sentences.en: unless she is guaranteed a vote to extend DACA, which expires in three weeks.
sentences.zh: 除非她能获得对延长“童年抵美者暂缓遣返计划”（DACA）进行投票的保证，该计划将于三周后到期。

sentences.en: Honor the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 尊重众议院。

sentences.en: Give us a chance to have a vote on the floor.
sentences.zh: 给我们一个在议会大厅投票的机会。

sentences.en: In a dramatic protest, Pelosi held court on the House floor for more than eight hours.
sentences.zh: 在一场戏剧性的抗议中，佩洛西在众议院会议厅发表了长达八个多小时的演讲。

sentences.en: I just got word that the House historian confirms you have now set the record for the longest continuous speech in the House since at least 1909.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚得到消息，众议院历史学家证实，你现在创下了自1909年以来众议院最长连续演讲的纪录。

sentences.en: I wonder what that was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是什么情况。

sentences.en: It's not clear if enough House Democrats will join Pelosi to endanger the bill, which the Senate, then House, are expected to vote on on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚是否有足够的众议院民主党人会加入佩洛西的行列，从而危及该法案，该法案预计将于周四在参议院和众议院进行投票。

sentences.en: And a senior White House official has resigned amid allegations by two ex-wives that he physically and emotionally abused them.
sentences.zh: 此外，一名白宫高级官员在两名前妻指控其进行身体和情感虐待后辞职。

sentences.en: The official, Rob Porter, served as Trump's staff secretary, controlling the president's schedule and what documents reach his desk.
sentences.zh: 这名官员罗伯·波特曾担任特朗普的幕僚秘书，负责控制总统的日程安排以及送达总统办公桌的文件。

sentences.en: Earlier this week, one of his ex-wives released a 2005 photograph showing what she said were bruises from Porter punching her in the face.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，他的一名前妻发布了一张2005年的照片，照片显示她脸上有多处淤青，她说这是波特殴打她造成的。

sentences.en: Rob has put out a statement, which I can read to you now, and I think it will address some of those other questions.
sentences.zh: 罗伯发表了一份声明，我现在可以为你读一下，我认为它会回答其他一些问题。

sentences.en: These outrageous allegations are simply false.
sentences.zh: 这些令人发指的指控纯属虚构。

sentences.en: I took the photos given to the media nearly 15 years ago, and the reality behind them is nowhere close to what is being described.
sentences.zh: 我近15年前交给媒体的那些照片，其背后的真相与现在所描述的情况完全不同。

sentences.en: At the White House on Wednesday, Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders defended Porter.
sentences.zh: 周三在白宫，新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯为波特进行了辩护。

sentences.en: I can tell you that Rob has been an effective in his role as staff secretary,
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，罗伯在担任幕僚秘书期间一直表现出色，

sentences.en: and the president and chief of staff have had full confidence and trust in his abilities and his performance.
sentences.zh: 总统和办公厅主任对他个人的能力和工作表现一直充满信心和信任。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为你准备节假日接待客人的相关内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人感到宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为喝醉而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么样的要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有过敏或食物敏感？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 你可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
